sub_graphs.title: EVM Trace: Transaction and Opcode Event Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the trace events emitted during transaction execution from start to completion

nodes.label: Transaction Execution Starting
nodes.description: EVM begins processing a transaction

nodes.label: Emit TransactionStart Event
nodes.description: Fire TransactionStart trace event to active tracer

nodes.label: Transaction Tracing Active
nodes.description: Tracer is receiving events for this transaction

nodes.label: Emit OpStart Event
nodes.description: Fire OpStart trace event before each opcode execution

nodes.label: Opcode Executing
nodes.description: Individual opcode being executed

nodes.label: Emit OpEnd Event
nodes.description: Fire OpEnd trace event after opcode completes

nodes.label: Opcode Complete
nodes.description: Opcode execution finished, ready for next

nodes.label: Emit OpException Event
nodes.description: Fire OpException trace event when opcode causes exception

nodes.label: Exception Recorded
nodes.description: Exception event captured by tracer

nodes.label: Emit PrecompileStart Event
nodes.description: Fire PrecompileStart when entering precompile execution

nodes.label: Precompile Tracing
nodes.description: Tracer tracking precompile execution

nodes.label: Emit PrecompileEnd Event
nodes.description: Fire PrecompileEnd when precompile completes

nodes.label: Emit GasAndRefund Event
nodes.description: Fire GasAndRefund to track gas deductions and refunds

nodes.label: Gas Tracking Updated
nodes.description: Gas consumption recorded by tracer

nodes.label: Emit EvmStop Event
nodes.description: Fire EvmStop when final opcode executes

nodes.label: EVM Stopped
nodes.description: EVM execution has terminated

nodes.label: Emit TransactionEnd Event
nodes.description: Fire TransactionEnd with gas consumed, output, and optional error

nodes.label: Transaction Trace Complete
nodes.description: All trace events for transaction have been emitted

ambiguities.text: The module states it 'does not implement trace collection itself' without specifying what trace collection entails
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume trace collection refers to actual storage, formatting, or transmission of trace data - implementers must provide these capabilities.

ambiguities.text: The EvmTracer Protocol requires __call__ but the exact type of 'evm: object' parameter is unspecified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'object' refers to the live EVM execution context, providing access to stack, memory, PC, and gas state.

implicit_assumptions.description: Custom tracer implementations are trusted and will not interfere with EVM execution
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious tracer could potentially modify EVM state or cause execution delays

implicit_assumptions.description: Tracing is disabled by default (using discard_evm_trace) and must be explicitly enabled
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Unexpected performance overhead if tracing were enabled by default

implicit_assumptions.description: Tracer callbacks execute quickly and do not significantly impact EVM execution time
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Transaction execution could be delayed by slow tracer implementations

implicit_assumptions.description: Trace data exposed to external tracers follows EIP-3155 format standards
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incompatibility with existing debugging and analysis tools expecting standard format
